title: ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - NEW BUSINESS
jobDescription: JOB SUMMARY The Account Executive – New Business will be responsible for driving new logo acquisition: identifying and engaging new prospects, building pipeline, articulating the value of location-intelligence Saa S solutions, negotiating and closing deals. Success will be measured by Qo Q new business revenue attainment, pipeline growth, and sales cycle effectiveness. JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES • Prospect, engage and qualify new business leads (self-generated and inbound) for Smart Market, Lepton’s location intelligence Saa S solution across targeted verticals and geography. • Manage the entire sales cycle including lead generation, discovery and needs analysis, solution presentation or demo, proposal creation, negotiation, and closure. • Develop and articulate compelling business cases and ROI for location intelligence solutions such as mapping, analytics, expansion planning, and network planning. • Work across target industries including Digital Natives, Mobility, Retail/FMCG, Telco, Logistics, BFSI, and Automotive. • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets. • Maintain a healthy pipeline and ensure accurate forecasting using CRM tools and dashboards. • Develop business opportunities through inside sales, marketing leads, social outreach, events, and referrals. • Collaborate closely with presales, product, delivery, and customer success teams to ensure smooth onboarding and high customer satisfaction. • Stay updated on market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging use cases in the location intelligence and geospatial analytics domain. • Provide feedback to marketing and product teams regarding market opportunities and positioning gaps. • Deliver compelling presentations, product demonstrations, and ROI/value proposition pitches. • Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in prospective organizations, including senior management and decision-makers, and build long-term trust and credibility. TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILL-SET & QUALIFICATIONS • 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, Saa S, or IT solution sales with a strong track record of new customer acquisition. • Bachelor’s degree is mandatory; MBA is preferred in Sales, Marketing, IT, Business Management, or a related field. • Strong history of achieving quarterly sales quotas. • Proven ability to generate pipeline independently through hunting, cold outreach, and networking. • Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills with experience engaging C-level stakeholders. • Understanding of software or technology value selling; exposure to analytics, GIS, location intelligence, Saa S, or data solutions is an advantage. • Hands-on experience in forecasting, CRM usage, and sales reporting. • High ownership mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. • Startup experience is a plus. • Willingness to travel for client meetings, demos, and industry events. Why Join Us • Opportunity to be part of a 10X growth journey with Lepton Saa S products. • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge location intelligence solutions impacting global brands and enterprises. • High-visibility role with strong performance-linked incentives and career growth potential. • Fast-paced and merit-driven work culture with opportunities to work on strategic industry verticals.

title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT – FOUNDER’S OFFICE
jobDescription: (A)JOB SUMMARY The Executive Assistant – Founder’s Office will work directly with the CEO, providing high-quality administrative and operational support. This is a high-visibility, high-responsibility role best suited for individuals who are extremely organized, discreet, proactive, and tech-savvy. The Executive Assistant will manage the CEO’s calendar, travel plans, communications, and day-to-day schedule, ensuring seamless execution of the CEO’s professional agenda. (B)JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITY •Calendar & Schedule Management: o Manage and maintain the CEO's daily, weekly, and monthly calendar with precision. o Schedule, confirm, and send reminders for internal and external meetings, calls, and events. o Proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and communicate updates to relevant stakeholders. •Travel Planning & Coordination: o Book flights, trains, hotels, and ground transportation for the CEO's domestic and international travel. o Prepare detailed travel itineraries including visa requirements, meeting briefings, and logistics. o Manage last-minute changes to travel plans and ensure contingency arrangements are in place. o Coordinate with travel vendors to ensure cost-effective and timely arrangements. •Meeting & Communication Support: o Prepare agendas, briefing notes, and pre-read materials ahead of important meetings. o Draft and manage emails, correspondence, and follow-up communications on behalf of the CEO. o Take minutes of key meetings and track action items to ensure timely closure. •Reminders & Task Tracking: o Send timely reminders to the CEO for upcoming meetings, deadlines, and commitments. o Maintain a structured task tracker for pending and completed CEO action items. o Coordinate with department heads on behalf of the CEO to gather updates and reports. •Administrative & Confidential Support: o Handle sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and confidentiality. o Manage personal and professional errands and requests as assigned by the CEO. o Organize and maintain filing systems for contracts, correspondence, and key business documents. (C)QUALIFICATION & SKILLSET •Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field from a reputed university. •1–2 years of professional or internship experience in an administrative, executive support, or business operations role. •Actively uses AI tools (Chat GPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar) in day-to-day work; familiarity with prompt engineering is a strong plus. •Quick learner — able to pick up new tools, workflows, and business contexts with minimal hand-holding. •Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills — articulate, precise, and professional; ability to draft high-quality correspondence independently. •Proficiency in productivity tools: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs) and MS Office Suite. •Extremely detail-oriented with strong time management and multitasking abilities. •High emotional intelligence and ability to work calmly under pressure. •Discretion, integrity, and a high degree of professionalism are non-negotiable. •Prior experience in an administrative or executive support role is preferred.

title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITY
1. Infrastructure & Virtualization Manage and optimize Pro Max-based VM clusters, including provisioning, backup strategies, and resource allocation. Develop reusable VM templates with preconfigured environments to standardize deployments. Automate VM lifecycle tasks (creation, patching, cleanup) using Ansible or similar tools. Implement user and access controls to ensure secure, auditable environments.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Implement Ia C practices (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.) to standardize infrastructure provisioning. Use Ansible/automation frameworks to script recurring workflows like backups, log rotation, and database initialization. Maintain a library of reusable scripts and playbooks to improve operational efficiency
3. Containerization & Application Platform Design, deploy, and maintain services using Docker and Docker Compose. Manage containerized stacks (including Supabase-like platforms) for consistency and scalability. Optimize resource utilization, lifecycle management, and monitoring across multi-node container deployments.
4. Database Administration (Postgre SQL) Install, configure, and maintain Postgre SQL databases across multiple environments. Plan and execute migrations, including splitting workloads into dedicated clusters. Implement HA, replication, and disaster recovery strategies. Apply best practices for database performance, tuning, and security. Establish a structured migration/versioning system for schema management
5. CI/CD & Deployment Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline builds, testing, and deployments. Manage deployments across multiple environments, including cloud-native platforms and modern hosting services like Vercel. Integrate infrastructure automation into pipelines to ensure consistency and reproducibility. Collaborate with development teams to optimize deployment workflows and rollback strategies.
6. Monitoring, Observability & Reliability Deploy and manage monitoring solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK) for systems and applications. Build dashboards, alerts, and usage reports to track performance, reliability, and API consumption. Drive incident response processes, including root-cause analysis and post-mortems.
7. Scalability & Security Implement scaling strategies for APIs and backend services (load balancing, caching, auto scaling). Enforce strong security practices for infrastructure, databases, and deployments. Continuously evaluate tools and frameworks to improve system efficiency and resilience. QUALIFICATION & SKILL-SET 3 – 7 years of experience in Dev Ops, SRE, or Infrastructure roles. Strong hands-on experience with Postgre SQL administration in production environments. Proficiency with Docker/Docker Compose and containerized application stacks. Experience with Supabase or similar database-driven Paa S. Skilled in CI/CD pipeline design (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins, etc.). Experience deploying to modern platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, or cloud-native Paa S. Proficiency in Ia C tools (Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Experience with virtualization platforms (Proxmox, VMware, KVM, or similar). Solid scripting/programming skills (Bash, Python, or Go). Familiarity with observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK). Strong understanding of Linux system administration, networking, and security. Nice-to-Have Skills Cloud provider experience (AWS, GCP, Azure) and hybrid infra management. Database optimization and query tuning experience. Knowledge of Kubernetes or Nomad for container orchestration. Experience with cost monitoring and optimization for infra and deployments. Why Join Us Shape the infrastructure for a next-generation data and geospatial analytics platform. Direct ownership of automation, monitoring, and deployment pipelines across multiple products. Collaborative and growth-oriented environment with opportunities to move into senior Dev Ops/SRE Architect roles
